description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the ClaimDao in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It includes setup code to initialize the DAO and populate test data, along with test methods for fetching claim requests by ID and list with filters.

classes.name: ClaimDaoRequestTest
classes.description: Test case class for testing ClaimDao methods related to claim request retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimDao instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a claim request by its ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of claim requests filtered by employee number.
